crossRefs.note: God who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
“But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.
Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
“Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.
God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.
Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory…
because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?
For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.
There is no umpire between us, that might lay his hand on us both.
oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my…
If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.

translations.web: If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’
translations.bsb: If it is a matter of strength, He is indeed mighty! If it is a matter of justice, who can summon Him ?
translations.kjv: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set
translations.asv: If we speak of strength, lo, he is mighty! And if of justice, Who, saith he, will summon me?
